system.description:
A flexible two-meter limb for field surgery: +2k0 on Medicae Tests, a bonus that also applies to rolls made to interrogate. Its six injector pistons each hold one drug dose (bought separately), and it can stop blood loss as a half action.

Its small chainscalpel serves as an improvised weapon dealing 1k1 damage with the user's Strength as normal. Only tech-priests can use mechadendrites, up to a number equal to their Constitution.
system.effectText: +2k0 Medicae (also interrogation), six drug pistons, stops blood loss as half action; chainscalpel 1k1 improvised weapon.
